claim: A 128K game can write port 0xFF for no reason a 128K sees, which on a Next selects Timex hi-colour and scrambles the picture; grep OUT (0xFF) in a plain conversion before designing.

evidence.text: The copy writes 2 then 3 to port 0xFF (ABEF, AC43); in a Next .nex this is Timex hi-colour and a scrambled picture, seen in JNext.
